accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.removeConfirm: Remove {{email}}? Its mail stays on the server; only this device forgets it.

account.name: Name
account.identitiesHint: Other addresses of this account you can write from, such as an alias on your own domain. Your mail server has to accept them.
account.colorHint: Marks mail from {{label}} where accounts appear together, as in All inboxes.

identity.title: Send-from address
identity.name: Display name (optional)
identity.duplicate: This address is already used by this account.

signature.title: Signature
signature.hint: Added to new messages, and above the quoted text of replies, sent from {{email}} or its other addresses.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.explanation: Off until you turn it on. To tell you about new mail, the mailbowox notification server keeps an encrypted copy of this account's password and uses it to watch the inbox. Notifications show the sender, subject and start of the message, readable only by this device.
notifications.browser: Shown by this browser while mailbowox is open in a tab. Nothing is sent to a server.
notifications.desktop: Shows the sender, subject and start of new mail. Closing the window keeps mailbowox in the menu bar or system tray, watching the inbox itself; quit it there to stop. Nothing is sent to a server.
notifications.browserDenied: Notifications are blocked for this site in the browser’s settings.
notifications.permissionDenied: Notifications are turned off for mailbowox in the system settings.
notifications.refused: The mail server refused the password.
notifications.failed: The notification server couldn't take this account (error {{status}}).

devices.title: Devices
devices.offHint: Sync keeps your accounts and settings on every device you use. They're encrypted on this device before they're stored on the sync server, which can't read them.
devices.onHint: Your accounts are encrypted on this device before they're stored on the sync server, which can't read them.
devices.turnOffConfirm: Turn off sync on this device? Your accounts stay here, and other devices keep syncing.
devices.deleteConfirm: Delete your accounts from the sync server? Sync turns off on every device. Your accounts stay on each of them.
devices.gatewayHint: The mailbowox sync server that keeps your encrypted accounts. It never sees your passwords.
devices.deriving: Securing your passphrase. This takes a few seconds.

setup.title: Set up sync
setup.headline: Sync your accounts
setup.intro: Your accounts and passwords are encrypted on this device with a key only your devices hold. To recover them on a new device without another one at hand, you enter your recovery email and this passphrase.
setup.emailHint: You type this address with the passphrase to unlock the vault on a new device. It is never sent anywhere.
setup.passphraseHint: Nobody can reset this passphrase. If you lose it and every linked device, the vault can’t be opened.

link.title: Link a device
link.headline: Scan this code
link.intro: On the new device, open mailbowox, choose Join from another device and scan this code.
link.qrLabel: Linking code for a new device
link.waiting: Waiting for the new device. The code changes every two minutes.
link.compare: Accept only if the new device shows the same number.
link.done: The new device now has your accounts and keeps them in sync.

join.title: Join
join.headline: Bring your accounts over
join.intro: Scan the code from a device that already syncs, or unlock the vault with your passphrase.
join.scanHint: On your other device, open Settings, Devices, Link a new device.
join.foreignCode: That isn’t a mailbowox linking code.
join.cameraNeeded: mailbowox needs the camera to scan the code on your other device.
join.cameraBlocked: Camera access is off for mailbowox. Turn it on in system settings, or use your passphrase.
join.compare: Check that your other device shows this number, then accept there.

errors.unreachable: Couldn’t reach the sync server at {{gateway}}. Check the address and your connection.
errors.gateway: The sync server answered with an error ({{status}}).
errors.decrypt: This vault couldn’t be decrypted. Check the passphrase, or link again from your other device.
errors.newerVersion: This vault was saved by a newer version of mailbowox. Update the app to keep syncing.
errors.unreadable: The vault on the sync server isn’t in a format mailbowox understands.
errors.noVault: No vault matches this email and passphrase on this sync server.
errors.busy: Another device kept changing the vault. Try again in a moment.
errors.expired: The other device didn’t answer in time. Scan a new code.
errors.off: Sync is off on this device.
errors.deleted: The synced data was deleted from another device, so sync is off. Your accounts are still here.

reading.title: Reading
reading.conversationsDetail: Shows a message and its replies, yours included, as one row.
reading.categoriesDetail: Sorts the inbox into Primary, Transactions, Updates and Promotions on this device. All keeps everything in one list.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.remoteHint: Remote images let senders see when and where you open their mail.
privacy.remoteSendersHint: Images from these senders load without asking. Choose one to go back to asking.
privacy.picturesDetail: Shows the picture a sender set on Gravatar, else their company's logo or website icon. Gravatar and those websites learn which addresses you look at.

crashReports.title: Crash reports
crashReports.explanation: Off by default. When on, a crash sends the error to the developers with the app version, device model and system version. Email addresses, server names, IP addresses and links are removed from the error first.

relay.title: Web relay
relay.hint: In the browser, mailbowox reaches your mail servers through a relay. The connection stays encrypted between this tab and your provider, so the relay can't read your mail.
relay.tokenHint: Whoever runs the relay gives you this code.
relay.needsUrl: Enter the relay address to continue.
relay.needsToken: Enter the access code to continue.
relay.invalid: Enter the relay address, starting with https:// or http://.
relay.unreachable: Nothing answered at {{url}}. Check the address, and that the relay is running.
relay.refused: The relay didn't accept this access code. Check it with whoever runs the relay.

about.title: About
about.privacy: mailbowox talks to your mail servers directly. No server of ours reads your mail, and the app collects no analytics.
